_readme: Add a device by adding an item to a category (or a new category). Put the photo in assets/images/facilities/ and set "image" to its file name; if "image" is empty the site looks for <id>.jpg, <id>.png or <id>.webp in that folder.

items.name: LiveAmp 32
specs: 32-Channel ultra-lightweight wearable wireless EEG system
24 referential + 8 bipolar ExG channel flexibility
24-bit A/D conversion with up to 1,000 Hz sampling rate
Integrated 3-axis accelerometer for movement tracking
MicroSD onboard recording & 2.4 GHz wireless telemetry

items.name: actiCHamp / actiCHamp Plus
specs: 64 Active EEG channels with actiCAP active electrode technology
High sampling rates up to 50 kHz with 24-bit per-channel resolution
8 integrated AUX ports for physiological sensors (EMG/ECG/EOG)
Dedicated lithium-ion PowerUnit for ultra-low noise recording
Multimodal synchronization with TMS, fNIRS, and eye-tracking

items.name: SynAmps2 / SynAmps RT
specs: 64 Monopolar + 4 Bipolar + 2 High-level channels (70 channels total)
High signal-to-noise ratio for ERP, EP, and cognitive EEG research
Up to 20,000 Hz sampling rate per channel
Integrated CURRY acquisition and signal processing suite
Quik-Cap sintered Ag/AgCl high-density electrode array

items.name: HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net (GES 400)
specs: 128-Channel high-density dense-array spatial EEG sampling
Saline-based HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net (HGSN) for rapid setup
Whole-head coverage for precise source localization & ERP analysis
Net Amps amplifier with high input impedance and ultra-low noise

items.name: Axxonet Xamp EEG / ERP System
specs: Dual multi-channel electrophysiology acquisition amplifiers
High sampling rate & 24-bit per-channel signal resolution
Integrated event-related potential (ERP) & EP software platform
Supports simultaneous multi-subject & clinical electrophysiology

items.name: Muse Headband
specs: 4 Dry EEG channels (AF7, AF8, TP9, TP10) plus reference
Multi-sensor array: EEG, PPG (heart rate), accelerometer & gyro
Real-time mobile wireless Bluetooth neurofeedback & tracking
Rapid deployment for ambulatory & field cognitive studies

items.name: Portable 4-Channel EEG Devices
specs: Compact 4-channel ambulatory EEG recording setups
Lightweight wearable design for mobile & ecological validity research
Real-time brainwave acquisition and wearable neurofeedback

items.name: Nihon Kohden Polysomnography System (32-Channel)
specs: 32-Channel clinical-grade sleep diagnostic & monitoring system
Comprehensive PSG montage: EEG, EOG, EMG, ECG, SpO2 & airflow
High CMRR (>105 dB) and low-noise amplifiers
Integrated Polysmith sleep scoring & analysis software suite

items.name: Nihon Kohden Polysomnography System (64-Channel)
specs: High-density 64-channel sleep acquisition & diagnostic system
Expanded EEG electrode placement for sleep neurodynamics
High sampling rate (up to 10,000 Hz) with IP-addressable junction boxes
Automated micro-arousal detection, sleep staging & HL7 integration

items.name: Soterix HD-tES / HD-tDCS System
specs: Non-invasive high-definition transcranial direct/alternating current stimulation
Targeted sub-centimeter focal cortical stimulation using 4x1 ring electrodes
Supports HD-tDCS, HD-tACS, and HD-tRNS precision protocols
Real-time impedance monitoring & current flow modeling integration

items.name: Soterix taVNS Portable Stimulator
specs: Transcutaneous Auricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation (taVNS) wearable unit
Targeted stimulation of auricular branch of vagus nerve (ABVN)
Modulates autonomic nervous system & locus coeruleus noradrenergic pathways
Compact, lightweight battery-powered design for field neuromodulation

items.name: HTC VIVE Mixed Reality Headsets
specs: Dual high-resolution immersive mixed reality (MR) & VR headsets
Sub-millimeter spatial tracking & high refresh-rate optics
Integrated for 3D virtual environments & neuro-behavioral experiments

items.name: Tobii Eye Tracker
specs: High-precision 120 Hz eye tracking and pupilometry system
Accurate fixation, saccade, and gaze-point dynamics capture
Hardware synchronization with EEG, fNIRS & stimulus software

items.name: NIRSport 2 fNIRS System
specs: Wearable multi-channel functional near-infrared spectroscopy system
Dual wavelengths (760 nm & 850 nm) for Oxy- and Deoxy-Hb tracking
Integrated 9-axis accelerometer & short-distance scalp noise filters
Supports multi-subject hyperscanning & co-registration with EEG/VR

items.name: PST Chronos Timing & Response Console
specs: Millisecond-accurate response collection engine for E-Prime & Psychopy
Multi-modal response keys, voice key, digital I/O & audio/visual timing
Hardware TTL trigger generation for microsecond EEG, PSG & fNIRS sync
Photo-sensor & microphone inputs for precise perceptual latency tracking

items.name: Auxiliary Multi-Parameter Physiological Sensors
specs: Photoplethysmography (PPG) pulse sensor for heart rate variability (HRV)
Continuous Pulse Oximetry (SpO2) blood oxygen saturation monitoring
Galvanic Skin Response (GSR) / Electrodermal Activity (EDA) skin conductance
Respiration effort belts, skin temperature & autonomic response transducers

items.name: High-Performance Neuroimaging Compute Server
specs: 2 TB high-speed ECC system memory for large-scale neuro-computation
Dual NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPUs (2x 40GB single-wide acceleration)
Accelerated deep learning, EEG source localization & microstate modeling
Pre-configured with EEGLAB, FieldTrip, Brainstorm, PyEEG, MNE-Python & PyTorch

items.name: High-Capacity Central Storage NAS
specs: 120 TB redundant RAID-backed NAS storage array for lab-wide data
Automated backup protocols for high-density EEG, PSG & fNIRS datasets
High-speed 10GbE network interconnect for multi-workstation data streaming
BIDS-compliant neuroimaging data repository & secure access controls
